about_the_game:
The free prologue of "Pax Autocratica" invites you to establish the foundations of the greatest regime in history in this darkly satirical totalitarian colony sim + FPS roguelite hybrid. You are tasked with managing and leading your citizens to spread your doctrine through the first sector "Elysia" and free it from the oppression of the current ruling power.

Add the Prologue to your wishlist to be notified on release. If you enjoy it, wishlist the full game.

Dictate wisely as your choices will shape society, for better or worse.

Notes about the Prologue:

The Prologue contains a limited portion of the full game. The scale of the base and the battles is smaller than in Early Access. Certain advanced systems, such as deeper automation, mechs, and other late‑game mechanics, are not available here. Content and balance may change before Early Access release.

Content Breakdown:

  • 1 space sector & boss (out of 4 in Early Access)

  • 50 roguelite buffs (out of 225)

  • 11 buildings (out of 65)

  • 6 weapons (out of 18)

  • 2 player classes (out of 9)

  • 7 troop types (out of 27)

  • 22 policies (out of 189)

Mold your populace by enacting tyrannical or benevolent reforms to sway your citizens’ Fear, Happiness, Hunger, and Loyalty.

Indoctrinate them through propaganda, surveillance towers, whippings, and public executions until even their dreams serve the State.

Or rise as the benevolent visionary of a new age, providing comfort, healthcare, and prosperity to those who once despaired.

Every decree shapes the soul of your regime, and the fate of those who live beneath it.

Build your state apparatus. Turn a handful of survivors into a tightly run, self-sustaining machine.

Expand your base from a cluster of shelters into an immense complex housing a growing population, each citizen serving the grand design of your regime.

Research new technologies, buildings, and doctrines to refine your colony’s efficiency and tighten your control.

Automate production lines and streamline logistics in the full game. In the Prologue, lay the groundwork and watch facilities hum with the cold precision of industry. Every upgrade is efficiency, every structure, a testament to your vision.

You, the Leader of Auroria, will venture into the frontier of the Tyris System to conquer the fractured territories ruled by rival regimes.

Conscript new citizens, gather vital resources, trade with wandering merchants, and influence local populations through decisive acts that shift the balance of power.

Then lead your forces into battle. From desperate skirmishes to large-scale mechanized battlefields of infantry, tanks, and mechs, each victory is another step in spreading the regime.

During each expedition, choose among dozens of roguelite buffs in the Prologue (hundreds in the full game) to forge your path toward absolute supremacy.

Each campaign strengthens your base, your army and you, the Leader, alike: new resources, new recruits, and experience that unlocks advanced class skills.

No two expeditions unfold the same.

Pax Autocratica is a totalitarian colony sim and FPS roguelite hybrid that combines base building, citizen management, and first-person tactical combat in a sci-fi dystopian world. It offers a dynamic, accessible, and approachable gameplay experience for all.

It’s a game about power. How it’s built, how it corrupts, and how it consumes.

You will command armies, dictate laws, and witness consequences in every face that salutes you or fears you.

THE STATE OBSERVES ALL

How will history remember your reign?

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1080p: Nvidia® GTX 1060 6G / RX 480 (6GB+ of VRAM) | 1440p: Nvidia® GTX 1070 8G / AMD Radeon RX Vega 56 (8GB+ of VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GTX 2060 Super / RX 5700 XT (8GB+ of VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space

short_description: Free stand‑alone Prologue. Shape a grand colony where every life bends to your will. Feel the weight of absolute power as you decree laws, then march into chaos, leading squads in roguelite FPS battles from brutal skirmishes to large-scale battlefields. Play Sector One now & wishlist the full game.
